I replied to Pree in our direct message: on 14 October she told me her cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork is 21 October from now on. I took that from her own message in our DM history, so nothing from outside her conversation was used.

One thing to know: my wrap-up from last time ended up in that DM as well (the line saying I saved the note in gbrain and confirmed it to her). It only mentions her own cutoff and is in her own DM, so nothing has been exposed, but she can see it.
